title: spin-noise network bundle metadata (meta.json), schema version 1.1
description: Metadata record placed at the root of every spin-noise bundle zip. Written by topspin/spin_noise_run.py, validated by uploader/upload_bundle.py --selftest. This file describes schema version 1.1 (adds the required 'software' object); the uploader still accepts bundles declaring schema_version 1.0 by relaxing exactly those two points. NOTE: the uploader ships a deliberately minimal built-in validator (type / required / enum / const / pattern / items only) so this schema intentionally avoids $ref, allOf, conditionals, and other advanced keywords.

schema_version.description: Version of this metadata schema. Bump only with coordinated uploader/server changes. History: 1.0 = initial contract; 1.1 = added the required 'software' object.

program_version.description: Version string of spin_noise_run.py that produced this bundle (kept for 1.0 continuity; duplicates software.script_version).

script_version.description: SCRIPT_VERSION constant of the spin_noise_run.py that wrote this bundle; matches the repository VERSION file for released code.

schema_version.description: Schema version the writing script targeted; duplicates the top-level schema_version for self-contained provenance.

script_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the running spin_noise_run.py file, computed at runtime (works without git on facility machines); 'unavailable' if it could not be determined. Optional.

run_mode.description: How the script ran: 'live' = real acquisition; 'simulate'/'desktest' = hardware commands mocked, bundle is a plumbing test, NOT data. Optional.

software.description: Provenance of the software that produced the bundle. Required from schema 1.1 onward.

created_utc.description: UTC timestamp of bundle creation, ISO 8601 with trailing Z, e.g. 2026-08-18T14:03:22Z.

local_timezone_offset_min.description: Local timezone offset from UTC in minutes at creation time (e.g. +120 for CEST). Lets us reconstruct local time-of-day for environmental-noise correlation.

facility_slug.description: Short lowercase identifier assigned by the maintainer; also appears in the bundle filename.

contact_email.description: Optional contact address; empty string if not provided. Only stored when contact_consent is true.

contact_consent.description: True only if the operator explicitly consented to storing contact_email.

console.description: e.g. Avance III HD, Avance NEO, as reported by uxnmr.info or the operator.

probe_string.description: Verbatim probe identification string (PROBHD / current probe).

probe_type.description: RT = room-temperature probe (expect Gueron absorption dip); cryoprobes expect emission bump.

coil_temp_k.description: RF coil temperature in kelvin if the console reports it; null otherwise.

preamp_temp_k.description: Preamplifier temperature in kelvin if known; null otherwise.

description.description: Free text, e.g. 'tap water', 'distilled water + 10% D2O'.

h2o_fraction_pct.description: Protonated-water fraction in percent. Critical: the spin-noise feature scales with proton density (the 2022 lesson).

vt_setpoint_k.description: Variable-temperature unit setpoint in kelvin; sample temperature enters the noise-power law via Ts.

locked.description: Whether the deuterium lock was engaged during the noise acquisition.

lock_sweep_confirmed_off.description: Operator explicitly confirmed the BSMS field sweep was OFF. A running sweep smears the noise feature by kHz and ruins the record.

operator_notes.description: Free text: construction nearby, elevator, He fill that morning, etc. Empty string allowed.

p90_us.description: Calibrated (or operator-entered) 1H 90-degree pulse length in microseconds.

p90_power_db_or_w.description: Power level at which p90_us applies. Number in dB (Avance III+) or watts; string allowed for legacy consoles that report e.g. '-6 dB PLW1'.

rg_ladder.description: Small-flip 1D acquisitions at increasing receiver gain, used offline to check receiver linearity.

topshim_ok.description: True if topshim ran and converged; false if unavailable or skipped.

pulprog.description: Pulse program name, e.g. 'zgnoise2d' for the noise block.

td1_rows.description: Number of pseudo-2D rows (1 for plain 1Ds).

started_local.description: Local wall-clock start, ISO 8601 without zone (zone given by local_timezone_offset_min).

checksums.description: Map from in-zip path (always under data/) to its SHA-256, e.g. {"data/12/ser": "sha256:ab12..."}.
